news.title: Nitro launcher refresh
news.body: Unique Nitro home layout, working controls, and cleaner navigation.

news.title: Nitro SMP
news.body: Live player count, ping, and one-click join from the Servers tab.

items: Friends search works without ntfy.sh — cracked/offline usernames can be found
Blue Nitro theme, Friends and Profiles in the top nav, bigger Servers page, and a black account menu
Removed cosmetics, custom skins manager, and animated capes from the client
Live remote partners, news, and changelog (no client update needed)
Owner tools for publishing launcher content in real time
Premium launcher redesign inspired by top commercial clients
Home: news, server status, and quick launch
Settings organized into Account / Graphics / Launcher / Minecraft / Performance / Downloads / Experimental
Prebuilt Nitro 1.8.9 — no Gradle build for players
Automatic Java 8 download and setup wizard
Server hub focused on Nitro SMP
Launcher mod toggles, resource pack slot, export/import settings
Performance mode stacks on top of presets instead of replacing them
Join Nitro SMP button on in-game welcome screen
